checks.requirement: Three connected pieces with distinct editorial purposes, arguments, synthesis, and meaningful limitations
checks.evidence: Piece 01 examines the October workflow update; 02 tests quality and control claims; 03 gives pre-release checks and developments to watch. Each connects multiple sources and states a limitation.

checks.requirement: At least three independent publishers supporting each article
checks.evidence: Piece 01 cites Suno, On a Creative Journey, and MusicRadar; 02 cites WaveDisco, ytyng, and two separate video publishers; 03 cites several distinct publishers and a podcast.

checks.requirement: Traceable evidence, factual scope, and uncertainty
checks.evidence: Claim IDs, source versions, quotations, and media timestamps are supplied. Several specific claims exceed the exact passages provided, and the podcast citation leads to a feed rather than a clearly identified episode.

checks.requirement: Approximately 600–900 words per article, excluding references
checks.evidence: The supplied articles appear near the requested range, but no word counts are supplied and an exact count cannot be established without counting the text.

checks.requirement: A 3–5 minute spoken script paired with each article
checks.evidence: All three scripts track their articles. Piece 01 has only a production target; piece 02 labels a four-minute runtime. No timed narration or finished video verifies duration, and the first two scripts may run short at ordinary speaking pace.

checks.requirement: RSS, YouTube, and podcast evidence across the series
checks.evidence: The articles use written reports and YouTube demonstrations; piece 03 cites the JG Beats Lab podcast. The supplied summary reports eligible items of all three kinds.

checks.requirement: As-of date tied to the evidence-supplying pipeline run and 30-day freshness
checks.evidence: Each draft states 2026-10-13 UTC, matching the supplied live run's as-of date. Supplied passage publication dates fall within that run's 30-day window.

checks.requirement: Source collection minimum and independence across the full corpus
checks.evidence: The run summary reports 21 eligible items, including two podcasts and two YouTube videos, from 12 publishers. The full item records and their substantive content are not supplied here.

checks.requirement: Two live runs on different days, publication, audience videos, and technical demonstration
checks.evidence: The submission explicitly says the second live run, three Substack publications, three YouTube videos, student approval, and separate technical demonstration are pending.

findings.location: Article, “What the measurements show,” paragraph 2; brief claim 02-c2
findings.issue: The reported disappearance of the WAV/MP3 loudness gap is not supported by the exact passages supplied for that claim.
findings.support: The supplied WaveDisco passages say there was no consistent v5.5-to-v6 direction in LUFS or True Peak and that only two songs had format comparisons. Neither passage states that the format gap disappeared.
findings.suggested_fix: Supply and cite the exact WaveDisco passage with the format result, or remove that result from the article and brief.

findings.location: Article, “Control needs its own test,” paragraphs 1–2; script, “Creative control is a separate test”
findings.issue: Several descriptions of the video tests are more specific than their supplied transcript excerpts establish.
findings.support: For 02-c4, the excerpts are “direction and then the next few have,” “It might just be Sunno doing iterations,” and “into studio, cleaned up all the the”; they do not themselves establish a smoother vocal. For 02-c5, the provided excerpts do not establish that Olsen retained the memo’s melody.
findings.suggested_fix: Check surrounding timestamped segments and attach passages containing the full assessments. Narrow any description that cannot be substantiated.

findings.location: Article, Olsen paragraph; script, Olsen paragraph; brief claim 02-c5
findings.issue: The stated paid-program incentive is not established by the supplied excerpt.
findings.support: The cited segment at 13:36 reads “Paid toMake Music Week, which is going”. That fragment does not show a paid music-business program or its relationship to Olsen’s Suno evaluation.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite a complete passage establishing the promotion and its commercial nature, or use a narrower attribution.

findings.location: Article, ytyng paragraph: “The measured difference is real within the files ytyng compared”
findings.issue: This wording treats a source-reported measurement as independently established.
findings.support: The exact passage says “v6 was down 2 to 3.4dB at 2 to 12kHz, and the spectral centroid was 36% lower.” No raw files, calculations, or independent replication are supplied.
findings.suggested_fix: Say that ytyng reported a difference in the exports it compared; retain the caveat about different songs, prompts, and codecs.

findings.location: Article and script source notes for the JG Beats Lab podcast
findings.issue: The reader-facing citation points to an RSS feed rather than an identified episode or a timestamped episode link.
findings.support: The supplied source URL is https://feeds.buzzsprout.com/2573904.rss. The draft gives 11:30–11:50 transcript times, while the assignment requires substantive claims to link to evidence with timestamps for audio.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a direct episode or playable audio link alongside the episode title and times.

findings.location: Article and script source note for Suno’s October 8 release note
findings.issue: The citation uses a general release-notes page that may be difficult for readers to locate after updates.
findings.support: The supplied URL is https://blog.suno.com/release-notes, and the draft relies on three passages attributed to October 8. The internal source version is traceable, but the audience-facing link has no entry anchor.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a stable October 8 entry link or archived snapshot if available, and keep the three quoted feature descriptions in the source note.

findings.location: SUBMISSION.md, Published Series and Evidence and Runs sections
findings.support: The supplied submission marks all three articles unpublished, all three videos unproduced, the technical demonstration unrecorded, and the second live run pending. The assignment requires those publications and a second live run on a different day.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete student review and corrections, run the pipeline on another day, produce and publish the three article/video pairs and technical demonstration, then verify and record accessible links.

strengths: The three pieces answer different editorial questions while maintaining one audience and topic.
The drafts generally distinguish announcements, creator accounts, inference, and unresolved outcomes.
The pieces avoid treating the Italian investigation, litigation allegations, or Deezer’s planned toggle as settled results.
limitations_of_this_audit: This audit used only the supplied assignment, drafts, summaries, and exact passages; it did not inspect links, source context, repository files, or media.
Exact article word counts and finished video durations are unverified.
The full corpus, second podcast item, implementation, and replay artifacts cannot be independently checked from the supplied material.
